Bug_Explanation: The method getNames() returns null instead of an empty List, which leads to a NullPointerException when trying to access the size of the list.
Trigger_Explanation: The generated JUNIT test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method, which internally calls getNames and returns null. When trying to access the size of the returned list, a NullPointerException is thrown.
Bug_Trigger_Explanation: The test results indicate that the test passed without throwing a NullPointerException, which contradicts the expectation set in the test code that a NullPointerException would be thrown. Therefore, the test results do not confirm that the bug was triggered.
